Home About Specialties Work With Me Book Contact

Reach out when you’re ready to take the next step

I offer short-term and open-ended therapy for anxiety, relationship strains, grief, and transitions. Use this page to ask a question, arrange an initial consult, or request a referral. I will respond within two business days.

Confidential Care

Conversations are private within clinical and legal limits. We’ll review limits to confidentiality in our first meeting.

Evidence-Informed

I blend cognitive, somatic, and relational approaches to meet you where you are.

Collaborative

You and I set goals together. Therapy is an active partnership across sessions.

How I work

I typically combine trauma-aware interventions, skill-building for anxiety, and relational exploration. Modalities include: {{MODALITIES}}. We'll tailor methods to fit your priorities and pace.

If you’re unsure

Worried therapy will be too intense, too slow, or not useful? We’ll begin conservatively — safety and stabilization first. A single consultation can help you decide.

Let’s find a time

Call, email, or use the form below. For immediate scheduling, click the primary action.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

Or email: {{EMAIL}}
Free guide

Download my brief workbook: 5 grounding practices for overwhelming days. I'll email it when you book an initial consult.

What people say

"I felt seen and understood from the first session. We built practical tools that actually fit my week."
— Client in {{CITY}}

"Compassionate, clear, and structured. I learned to manage panic without feeling controlled by it."
— Confidential review

Care offerings

Short-term focused work (6–12 sessions) and longer, open-ended therapy. Sliding-fee options may be available on a limited basis — ask when you contact me.

View scheduling options

Insurance and self-pay discussed during intake.

Scope & safety

I provide psychotherapy for adults in private practice. I do not provide emergency services. If you or someone else is in crisis or danger, call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency department. Messages sent via this site or email are not monitored 24/7.

Confidentiality is honored within legal and ethical limits; we will review these during intake. If you are calling from outside {{STATE}}, we will confirm licensure and telehealth eligibility.

Licensure: {{LICENSE}}. Professional boundaries and record-keeping practices will be discussed in your first session.

The design follows an "aura_editorial" aesthetic: strong typographic hierarchy, high contrast, and an intentional editorial layout. Files included in this chunk: - contact.html — Complete contact page with the required section ripple (hero, values, methods, objections, testimonials, lead_magnet, cta). This page is designed to be linked from index.html and other pages. Placeholders used (replace these during deployment): - {{BUSINESS_NAME}} - {{TAGLINE}} - {{PHONE}} - {{EMAIL}} - {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} - {{PRIMARY_CTA_URL}} - {{THERAPIST_NAME}} - {{LICENSE}} - {{MODALITIES}} - {{CITY}} - {{STATE}} Notes for integrators / editors: - The contact page intentionally re-uses and summarizes key sections from the site so visitors can access values, methods, and social proof while contacting the clinician. - The contact form's action uses the placeholder {{PRIMARY_CTA_URL}}. Replace it with your scheduling endpoint, form handler, or mailto as appropriate. - No external assets or CDNs are referenced. SVG artwork (assets/img/hero.svg, assets/img/avatar.svg, assets/img/pattern.svg) should be provided in the assets/img folder elsewhere in the project; this page assumes those assets exist for the broader site design. Clinical & legal requirements included on the page: - Confidentiality note and limits - Crisis disclaimer (not an emergency service) - Licensure placeholder - A scope statement clarifying adult psychotherapy and telehealth/licensure considerations Accessibility & behavior: - Use semantic headings and form labels.
